checks: resolve each signed work_binding_v2 to the exact root package and authority hashes
require exact trusted action, semantic, resource, time and request correspondence
require the signed work binding value_request to match the authority value_binding and exact declared amount when caller-declared value is used
require the signed provider wire body and exact-review commitments to match downstream evidence
require exercised_by to match the root principal or exact signed lane delegation
require the authenticated credential identifier digest to be signed into the child binding
require value_binding none to carry no monetary reservation or consumption
require declared_bounded value to match the exact signed request
require provider_verified value to resolve one supported signed provider fact bound to the exact request and provider body
non_claims: does not establish current dispatch-time liveness
does not establish provider outcome or settlement
